The *Sucarita Sutta* ("Good Conduct", Iti 65; It 3.16, PTS It 55) is a short canonical discourse in the *Itivuttaka* of the Khuddaka Nikāya. The sutta concisely expounds the three kinds of good conduct (bodily, verbal, and mental).
